data.name: Dhirendra
data.gender_notes: Dhirendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhirendra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dhi' meaning 'thought' and 'indra' meaning 'ruler'. This name signifies one who rules over thoughts and has the power to control and direct them. The name Dhirendra carries the meaning “Ruler of Thoughts” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhirendra usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of thoughts and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhirendra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of Thoughts.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhirendra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
